raw.description:
The Role

We are seeking a Controls Engineer (m/f/d) to work on the local controller that runs at the heart of our customers' power plants. You will design and build the control logic that keeps solar, BESS, and thermal generation assets operating safely and efficiently. A passion for the energy transition and interest in physical systems behind the code is highly valued.

Tasks

What You’ll Do:

  • Design and maintain control algorithms for our Rust-based controller.
  • Translate control theory and power grid compliance requirements into clean, well-tested code.
  • Collaborate on the development of control algorithms for power distribution, anomaly detection, error handling and electric/thermal/economic optimization.
  • Collaborate with engineers to validate controller behavior against real-world conditions.
  • Build software interfaces to communicate directly with plant hardware via protocols like Modbus, CAN, and M-Bus.
  • Support commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting of controllers.

Requirements

What You Bring:

  • Experience in Rust, or strong proficiency in another systems language such as C/C++.
  • Comfort with concurrent, real-time, programming close to the hardware layer.
  • Knowledge of, or strong curiosity about control systems or power systems.
  • Clear, proactive communication skills.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with industrial protocols (Modbus, CAN, M-Bus).
  • Background in power systems, solar assets, battery energy storage systems (BESS) or similar.

Benefits

Why join H.E.A.T.?

  • Future-Proof Career: Gain deep knowledge of the fast growing renewable energy sector and accelerate the global energy transition.

If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.

  • PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI

  • Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
  • Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
  • Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
  • Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
  • OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary

  • Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
  • Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
  • Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
  • Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
  • Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus
  • Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus
  • Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build
  • Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen

title: Senior Technical Program Manager I
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><p><strong>Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands</strong><br><strong>Travel: </strong>up to 40% within DACH, Benelux, Nordics (an other European countries as needed)<br><strong>Reports to:</strong> Director, Professional Services, EMEA<br>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Your Impact</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you’ll lead high-visibility projects, directly contributing to the development and implementation of solutions that truly make a difference. In this role, you’ll tackle complex challenges, working with some of the most advanced technologies in the industry, including cloud and on-prem platforms, and mission-critical systems. You’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with brilliant minds across professional services, sales, engineering, product, and customer teams to deliver solutions that save lives and enhance public trust.<br><br>At Axon, we’re driven by a powerful mission: to protect life, capture truth, and accelerate justice. We’re growing rapidly, and this is your chance to make a lasting impact at a company where innovation meets purpose.</p> <h2><br><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <p><br><strong>Program &amp; Project Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage all aspects of complex enterprise-grade product deployments</li> <li>Oversee project milestones, resource planning, scope, timeline, and risk management.</li> <li>Manage cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment, transparency, and on-time delivery.</li> <li>Ensures project milestones and deadlines are met and associated documentation supports customer acceptance for purposes of revenue recognition</li> <li>Support pre-sales scoping and post-sales implementation handoff.</li> <li>Operates with a sense of urgency, accuracy, and detail-orientation, while maintaining consistent lines of communication with all teams involved in each project</li> <li>Maintain customer confidence, especially in high-pressure situations</li> <li>Remain organized and focused on removing obstacles through creativity and adaptation to rapidly changing circumstances</li> </ul> <p><strong>Partner Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the relationship with 3rd party integrator and the client throughout the length of the contract</li> </ul> <p><strong>Stakeholder Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work closely with Professional Services, Product Managers, and Engineers to align program execution with business goals.</li> <li>Act as a liaison between customers and internal teams to manage change requests, solution feasibility, and roadmap alignment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process Improvement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify process inefficiencies and propose improvements to increase deployment speed, quality, and customer satisfaction.</li> <li>Contribute to internal SOPs, implementation playbooks, and best practices.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You Bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Fluency in both German and English</li> <li>European citizenship is required in order to work with sensitive Government data, willing to undergo a security check</li> <li>5+ years of experience leading and delivering highly complex programs, with demonstrated success in technical program management.</li> <li>Proven track record of managing enterprise-level software deployments, infrastructure projects, or large-scale enterprise application programs.</li> <li>Deep expertise in delivering complex projects involving cross-functional teams, including sales, engineering, and product.</li> <li>Mastery of program/project management tools and methodologies to track, report, and deliver on objectives. (PMP, PRINCE2, SCRUM)</li> <li>Experience gathering requirements, optimizing workflows, and facilitating change management within teams.</li> <li>Familiarity with software configurations and coding experience (particularly JSON) preferred.</li> <li>Advanced communication and presentation skills, with the ability to distill technical concepts for diverse audiences.</li> <li>Proficiency in guiding client and internal teams through ambiguity, driving alignment, and executing on shared goals.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.</p> <p>Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p> <p><strong>Important Notes</strong></p> <p><em>The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. title: Functional Consultant & Project Manager
description: Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership. Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scaleups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base. We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK with the launch of our London office. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today. Location This is a full-time position. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (if you are not located in the Zurich area), the role will be based remotely from Germany or Austria or onsite in Zurich. As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month — these visits are financially supported by BLP. Your Mission As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you’ll operate at the intersection of business and tech — leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You’ll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you. Key Responsibilities Own the implementation journey end-to-end — from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement. Translate complexity into clarity — design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals. Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers’ unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems. Be the client’s trusted partner — anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp’s automation. title: Interim project - Senior DevOps Consultant (f/m/d)
description: Job description We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Consultant to support a defined project at our Headquarters in Berlin. The assignment is focused on the set-up and further development of our data management and infrastructure platform. The initial consulting engagement is planned for six months, with the possibility of extending the assignment for a further period, potentially up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement. The consultant will provide specialist DevOps and data-platform expertise within the scope of the project. The assignment is structured as an independent consulting engagement, with responsibility for delivering agreed project outcomes and technical solutions. The project supports our Climate Policy Team, which is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, evaluation of emissions scenarios, the 1.5°C global warming limit and evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites. As part of the assignment, the consultant will work on the shared data platform and infrastructure used across the organisation. Our platform is self-hosted on our own hardware and currently runs PostgreSQL, MinIO, GitLab CI/CD and containerised workloads on Linux. The consultant is expected to organise and perform the assignment independently, within the agreed project scope and in coordination with relevant project stakeholders. Your responsibilities Build and operate the data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning DevOps and data engineering work. Take the platform from single-server deployments to properly separated environments, with orchestration and infrastructure as code. Establish and improve the platform's operational practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, capacity planning and performance optimisation. Design and implement the access, identity and secrets model across platform and shared infrastructure. Contribute to the standardisation of production data workflows and platform standards across the organisation. Document what you build (runbooks, architecture notes and handover material) to ensure continuity. Provide technical guidance to data analysts and scientists and support the adoption of good practice in DataOps, security and governance. Evaluate new tools and technologies, run proof-of-concepts, and help define the technical roadmap for our infrastructure. Your profile Relevant Tech Skills Required: Python and shell scripting. Linux servers in production. Container orchestration you have operated yourself, including cluster setup and upgrades (Kubernetes, Docker). Infrastructure as Code and configuration management (Ansible, or equivalent). Operational experience with PostgreSQL (backup and point-in-time recovery, tested restores, version upgrades and connection pooling). Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana) and alert design. A solid understanding of distributed systems in an on-premise context. Nice to have: S3-compatible object storage operations (MinIO, Ceph). Identity and directory services like LDAP, Keycloak, or SSO integration across self-hosted tools. Virtualisation platforms (Proxmox, KVM). Have actively applied data governance principles to manage data quality, security, and compliance, and understand how to implement controls that protect sensitive information. Some experience deploying AI projects. Qualifications You will ideally have the following qualifications and skills: You have more than 5 years of experience operating Linux servers in production, including on-premise or bare-metal environments (not exclusively managed cloud). Proven ability to build automated pipelines that streamline development, testing and deployment for data-related projects.   • Creatives: Konzeption, Briefing und Erstellung von Ad-Creatives (Video, Statics, UGC) – hands-on, mit AI-gestützten Tools und in Zusammenarbeit mit Freelancern; Auswertung der Performance auf Creative-Ebene
  • CRM & Retention: Weiterentwicklung unseres E-Mail- und WhatsApp-Marketings – Kampagnenplanung, Segmentierung und der Ausbau automatisierter Flows
  • SEO & GEO: Sicherstellen unserer Auffindbarkeit bei Google sowie in AI-Assistenten wie ChatGPT, Claude oder Perplexity
  • AI & Prozesse: Aufbau und Etablierung von AI-gestützten Workflows im Marketing – von Creative-Produktion über Content-Erstellung bis Reporting und Analyse
  • Wachstum: Identifikation und Test neuer Kanäle und Hebel (z. B. weitere Marktplätze, internationale Märkte) sowie Weiterentwicklung unserer Kampagnen rund um Saison-Peaks und Produkt-Launches
  • Shop & Landingpages: Bau und Optimierung von Landingpages, Kampagnenseiten und Shop-Elementen direkt in Shopify – Conversion-Optimierung entlang der gesamten Customer Journey
  • Reporting & Steuerung: Aufbau eines klaren Marketing-Reportings (Kanal-Performance, CAC, ROAS, Retention) und laufende Auswertung von Traffic, Conversion und Nutzerverhalten – daraus leitest du Maßnahmen und Budgetallokation ab

Qualifikation

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Meta Ads und Google Ads sowie im Umgang mit Tracking- und Analyse-Tools (GA4, Google Tag Manager, Shopify-Reporting o. ä.)
  • Erfahrung mit E-Mail- und CRM-Tools (z. B. Klaviyo, chatarmin) sowie ein gutes Gespür für Zielgruppen, Segmentierung und Retention
  • Solides SEO-Verständnis und Neugier auf GEO – du beobachtest aktiv, wie sich Suche durch AI-Assistenten verändert
  • Aktive Nutzung von AI-Tools in der täglichen Arbeit und Freude daran, Prozesse damit neu zu denken
  • Grundkenntnisse in HTML, CSS und JavaScript sowie idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit Shopify (Theme-Anpassungen, Liquid, Apps)
  • Analytisches Denken, sicherer Umgang mit Zahlen und Excel/Google Sheets – Entscheidungen triffst du datenbasiert
  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Hands-on-Mentalität – du konzipierst nicht nur, du setzt auch um
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau; Interesse an Darts ist kein Muss, hilft aber

Benefits

  • Jahresbruttogehalt zwischen 53.000 bis 58.000 Euro – je nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung
  • Volle Ownership für unterschiedliche Marketing Kanäle eines wachsenden D2C-Unternehmens mit gemeinsamen Media-Budget im siebenstelligen Bereich
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, kurze Entscheidungswege und großer Gestaltungsspielraum – neue Ideen werden getestet, nicht diskutiert
  • Hybrides Arbeiten möglich, Büro in Berlin-Charlottenburg mit sehr guter ÖPNV-Anbindung

  • Kostenlose Getränke und Kaffee am Arbeitsplatz
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte auf unser gesamtes Sortiment

raw.description:
Die P&P Group ist operativer Immobilieninvestor und Investorenplattform mit Standorten in Fürth und London. Mit ausgezeichneter Technikexpertise und über 30-jähriger Historie realisieren wir anspruchsvolle Immobilienprojekte im Wohnsegment. Gründer der P&P Group ist Michael Peter, der zusätzlich über Rivus Capital im Bereich Private Equity investiert.

Freuen Sie sich auf spannende Projekte, ein dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld und die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen aktiv einzubringen.

Aufgaben

  • Beratung von Kaufinteressenten zu individuellen Finanzierungsmöglichkeiten im Rahmen des Immobilienerwerbs
  • Analyse der persönlichen und wirtschaftlichen Ausgangssituation sowie Entwicklung geeigneter Finanzierungskonzepte
  • Betreuung von Kapitalanlegern mit Schwerpunkt auf der Finanzierung von Kapitalanlageimmobilien
  • Auswahl geeigneter Banken und Finanzierungspartner sowie Einholung und Vergleich entsprechender Angebote
  • Steuerung des Finanzierungsprozesses von der ersten Prüfung bis zur Finanzierungszusage und erfolgreichen Kaufabwicklung
  • Identifikation potenzieller Finanzierungshürden und Entwicklung lösungsorientierter Ansätze in Abstimmung mit Kunden und Finanzierungspartnern
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Immobilienvertrieb zur Unterstützung eines erfolgreichen Verkaufsabschlusses
  • Pflege und Ausbau langfristiger Geschäftsbeziehungen zu Banken und Finanzierungspartnern

Qualifikation

  • Erfolgreich abgelegte IHK-Prüfung als Immobiliardarlehensvermittler gemäß § 34i GewO bzw. entsprechende Erlaubnis
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Immobilienfinanzierung, idealerweise mit Erfahrung im Bankenumfeld
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Finanzierung von Wohn- und insbesondere Kapitalanlageimmobilien
  • Erfahrung in der Beratung und Betreuung von Kapitalanlegern
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis bankseitiger Anforderungen und Entscheidungsprozesse bei Immobilienfinanzierungen
  • Idealerweise ein bestehendes Netzwerk zu Banken und Finanzierungspartnern
  • Ausgeprägtes wirtschaftliches Verständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, auch komplexe Finanzierungssituationen strukturiert und lösungsorientiert zu bearbeiten
  • Souveränes Auftreten, Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsgeschick sowie ausgeprägte Kunden- und Vertriebsorientierung

Benefits

  • Attraktive und leistungsgerechte Vergütung
  • Empfehlungsprämie „Mitarbeiter werben Mitarbeiter“
  • 30 Urlaubstage plus jeweils ein halber freier Tag an Heiligabend und Silvester
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Homeoffice-Möglichkeit (1 Tag pro Woche nach der Probezeit)
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • E-Scooter für flexible Mobilität
  • Team- und Firmenevents (Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier)
  • Kostenlose Parkplätze direkt vor der Tür sowie eine gute Verkehrsanbindung

description: <p>Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at <a href="https://bitwarden.com/">bitwarden.com</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p>Bitwarden is expanding its sales footprint and is looking for an Account Executive focused on the DACH region, professional fluency in English and German is required. This remote role can be based anywhere within the UK.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are seeking an energetic and motivated sales professional with strong sales skills and channel experience to join our team. The ideal candidate will have 4-8 years of new account or business development experience with a proven track record of engaging the Partner ecosystem to drive success. In your role, you will be responsible for achieving an assigned quota number while also managing lead flow, closing deals, recruiting partners and developing geographical go to market plans.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <ul> <li>Effective prospecting and lead management building a 3-5X pipeline within your territory</li> <li>Predominant focus on closing business in companies with 1000+ employees</li> <li>Managing and reporting a sales pipeline within our CRM, bringing the visibility of the revenue accurately, quarterly</li> <li>Territory planning and any sales support required</li> <li>Focus on activities and opportunities delivering short term and long-term revenue</li> <li>Effective and regular networking to attract and influence Partner sales and grow our Partner relationships</li> <li>Use your existing relationships to recruit and onboarding new partners, get them to agree to engage in proactive demand generation activities</li> <li>Maintain a regional partner plan mapping partner strengths (customer relationships, vertical focus, technology specialty) to accounts and target opportunities</li> <li>Track and manage lead flow both inbound and outbound between partners and the Bitwarden Sales team. Proactively communicate with Bitwarden sales leaders on the channel pipeline and forecast</li> <li>Work closely with marketing to deliver marketing events/programs/campaigns that create interest and awareness among partners’ customers. Build and execute joint partner business plans with measurable success</li> <li>Set financial goals for focus partners and ensure goals achievement&nbsp;</li> <li>Drive multiple key channel initiatives in parallel across technical, professional services, and sales</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience</li> <li>4-8 years of outside high-tech IT sales experience. IT security product experience is desirable but not mandatory</li> <li>Experience at a startup or pre $100M revenue company is desirable</li> <li>A proven track-record of driving continued partner growth and revenue</li> <li>Knowledge and strong relationships with SMB and SME focused resellers and MSP partners within a multistate region will be necessary</li> <li>Ability to drive influence and build effective relationships with decision makers across all levels of partner organizations</li> <li>Motivated and focused self-starter with strong leadership skills who can multitask, work independently or within a team</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills including listening, writing and public speaking.</li> <li>Can work in a fast paced, start-up environment</li> <li>An avid channel leader who knows how to teach, enable and motivate partners to find and close business</li> <li>Relationships and strong relationships with top VARs and Integrators</li> <li>Must demonstrate a consistent track record of achieving annual quota targets while providing specific details on key customer wins</li> <li>Possesses a competitive attitude, strong work ethic and thrives in a fast pace, high growth and matrixed organizational environment</li> <li>Positive history of collaborative selling</li> <li>Must be a proficient user of CRM tools and other Gsuite and MS Office tools</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Screening call with our Recruiting team</li> <li>Interview with our Head of EMEA Sales</li> <li>Interview with our Head of Sales Enablement</li> <li>Interview(s) with the team</li> <li>AE Roleplay Interview</li> </ul> <p><strong>A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US</strong></p> <ul> <li>Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone––from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.</li> <li>Become an expert in a growing market. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.</li> <li>Learn and grow professionally. Embrace the opportunity to build up your demand generation and product-led growth expertise in a fast-growing startup.</li> <li>We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <p data-start="213" data-end="305">AI is fundamentally changing how developers write, understand, debug, and maintain software.</p> <p data-start="307" data-end="665">At JetBrains, we're exploring what an AI-native development experience should look like for C++ developers. We are looking for a senior technical leader to help shape this future by building AI-powered workflows, integrating coding agents into developer tools, and defining how CLion can become a first-class environment for AI-assisted software development.</p> <p data-start="667" data-end="1126">This is a highly hands-on role focused on technical leadership rather than people management. You should expect to spend most of your time prototyping, implementing, and validating AI-powered workflows while helping shape technical direction through hands-on engineering. You'll work at the intersection of developer tools, AI agents, IDE architecture, and product strategy while helping define how software developers work with AI in the future.</p> <h3><strong>Example problems you'll work on:</strong></h3> <ul data-start="1257" data-end="1772"> <li data-section-id="1kr8jn4" data-start="1257" data-end="1341">How can coding agents become more effective when working with large C++ codebases?</li> <li data-section-id="1grdqsk" data-start="1342" data-end="1472">How can CLion's debugging, code understanding, and navigation capabilities be integrated into AI-assisted development workflows?</li> <li data-section-id="1a96z5j" data-start="1473" data-end="1584">How should AI-powered developer experiences be evaluated and benchmarked in real-world development scenarios?</li> <li data-section-id="x2tg27" data-start="1585" data-end="1657">What capabilities should AI agents have access to inside a modern IDE?</li> <li data-section-id="1h33vb4" data-start="1658" data-end="1772">How can we make CLion a better environment for developers who increasingly collaborate with AI tools and agents?</li> </ul> <h3><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></h3> <ul> <li data-section-id="ulv941" data-start="167" data-end="285">Shape and deliver AI-powered features for CLion and C++ development workflows.</li> <li data-section-id="lhgmb6" data-start="286" data-end="417">Design the architecture for AI integrations, agent tools, and C++-specific AI capabilities.</li> <li data-section-id="dripig" data-start="418" data-end="591">Build practical benchmarks and evaluation frameworks for AI-assisted C++ development scenarios.</li> <li data-section-id="1gmdjb8" data-start="592" data-end="750">Prototype and validate new AI workflows, including debugging, code understanding, refactoring, and project navigation.</li> <li data-section-id="1qfb96v" data-start="751" data-end="923">Collaborate with product managers, ML engineers, QA engineers, stakeholders, and senior developers to shape and deliver the roadmap.</li> <li data-section-id="cg7clz" data-start="924" data-end="1109">Work closely with JetBrains AI, ML, and product teams to help define the AI strategy for the C++ ecosystem.</li> <li data-section-id="1ew61mo" data-start="1110" data-end="1273">Evaluate and prioritize AI initiatives, bringing new ideas and proposals that align with the broader JetBrains AI strategy.</li> <li data-section-id="mf99vh" data-start="1274" data-end="1465">Contribute hands-on to technical design, software architecture, and implementation in a large, mature codebase.</li> <li data-section-id="1j853ei" data-start="1466" data-end="1604">Help define a technical roadmap for AI agent and tool integrations in C++ development workflows.</li> <li data-section-id="10l7mut" data-start="1605" data-end="1737">Build trust and alignment across the C++ Ecosystem, AI, Product, QA, and ML organizations</li> </ul> <h3><strong>We'd love to talk if you have:&nbsp;</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Significant software engineering experience as a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, Technical Lead, or similar senior technical role.</li> <li>Strong experience with Kotlin, Java, or other JVM technologies, or the ability to quickly become productive in a JVM-based codebase.</li> <li>Experience building AI-powered products, developer tools, coding assistants, agents, or LLM-based workflows.</li> <li data-section-id="u914ku" data-start="4530" data-end="4665">Strong understanding of how modern coding agents operate, including tool calling, context management, MCP, and evaluation techniques.</li> <li data-section-id="878m62" data-start="4755" data-end="4843">A track record of driving technical direction in ambiguous and rapidly evolving areas.</li> <li data-section-id="1lcrl1i" data-start="4844" data-end="4932">Strong product instincts and an ability to balance innovation with practical delivery.</li> <li data-section-id="vtnivs" data-start="4933" data-end="5020">Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence without formal authority.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to have</strong></h3> <ul data-start="1342" data-end="1687"> <li data-section-id="1b3ujlt" data-start="1342" data-end="1462">Experience with C++ development workflows, compilers, debuggers, language tooling, or developer productivity products.</li> <li data-section-id="p2q2va" data-start="1463" data-end="1569">Experience with IDE internals, language servers, code analysis, refactoring systems, or static analysis.</li> <li data-section-id="1axscea" data-start="1570" data-end="1633">Experience leading small teams or acting as a technical lead.</li> <li data-section-id="ny4zci" data-start="1634" data-end="1687">Experience working on AI-native developer products.</li> </ul> <h3 data-section-id="ctb2ez" data-start="4418" data-end="4445"><strong>Why this role is unique</strong></h3> <p data-start="4781" data-end="5174">Rather than building generic chat experiences, you'll be working on challenges such as AI-assisted debugging, agent-powered code understanding, developer workflow automation, and evaluation systems for AI-powered development tools. Your work will directly influence products used by millions of developers worldwide and help shape JetBrains' broader vision for AI-powered software development.</p> <h3><strong>Why join JetBrains?&nbsp;</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.</li> <li>Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.</li> <li>Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.</li> <li>Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.</li> <li>Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family</li> <li>Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.</li> <li><strong>Relocation support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.</li> <li>Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.</li> <li>Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.</li> </ul> <p>*Some benefits may vary depending on location.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-DNI</span><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We are an equal opportunity employer</strong><br><br>We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. title: Director, Customer Success, EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h3>Position overview</h3> <p>GitLab is looking for a strategic, commercially minded, and operationally rigorous Director of Customer Success to lead our EMEA Customer Success Management &amp; Architecture (CSMA) and Customer Success Engineering (CSE) organizations.</p> <p>This leader will own the regional customer-success operating model across relationship management, adoption architecture, technical enablement, customer health, and outcome realization. The role brings together the strengths of CSMA and CSE so customers can move from implementation to adoption, measurable business outcomes, expansion, and renewal with a consistent experience.</p> <p>You will lead through managers and senior leaders, build a high-performing all-remote organization, and partner closely with Sales, Renewal Management, Professional Services, Support, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success Operations.</p> <h3>What you will do</h3> <h4>Set the regional customer-success strategy</h4> <ul> <li>Translate GitLab’s customer-outcomes strategy into a clear EMEA plan for CSMA and CSE.</li> <li>Define the regional engagement model, coverage strategy, segmentation, capacity model, and operating rhythm across dedicated, pooled, and scaled motions.</li> <li>Establish a single view of the customer journey, from onboarding and implementation through adoption, optimization, expansion, and renewal.</li> <li>Ensure the organization consistently connects GitLab adoption to customer-defined business outcomes—not activity, features, or meetings alone.</li> <li>Represent EMEA customer needs and patterns in global Customer Success strategy and planning.</li> </ul> <h4>Lead CSMA and CSE as one integrated organization</h4> <ul> <li>Build strong alignment between CSMA relationship leadership and CSE technical expertise, with clear roles, handoffs, decision rights, and escalation paths.</li> <li>Ensure every appropriate customer has a current success plan with measurable outcomes, milestones, owners, risks, and next actions.</li> <li>Create a consistent approach to adoption architecture, use-case progression, technical enablement, and value realization.</li> <li>Develop scalable programs—such as webinars, hands-on labs, office hours, adoption plays, and executive engagements—that increase customer reach and impact.</li> <li>Partner with Professional Services to create continuity from implementation through adoption, including high-quality handoffs and clear ownership after delivery.</li> <li>Ensure CSE capacity is focused on the moments that most improve adoption, time-to-value, customer health, and expansion readiness.</li> </ul> <h4>Drive adoption, outcomes, and GitLab platform value</h4> <ul> <li>Make product adoption and verified customer outcomes the centre of the operating model.</li> <li>Build the capabilities required to help customers adopt GitLab’s strategic use cases, including GitLab Duo and the Duo Agent Platform where relevant to customer objectives.</li> <li>Use product-usage data, customer feedback, success-plan progress, and health signals to identify risk and prioritize intervention.</li> <li>Establish repeatable plays to accelerate onboarding, remove adoption blockers, increase breadth and depth of use, and support customers in achieving measurable value.</li> <li>Partner with Sales and Renewal Management to turn adoption progress and outcome evidence into a credible expansion and renewal narrative.</li> </ul> <h4>Own operational excellence and business performance</h4> <ul> <li>Establish a disciplined cadence for forecasting, customer health, risk management, pipeline inspection, capacity planning, and performance reviews.</li> <li>Define a balanced scorecard for CSMA and CSE that includes customer outcomes, adoption, retention health, expansion influence, coverage, productivity, quality, and team development.</li> <li>Improve data quality and operational consistency across Gainsight, Salesforce, reporting dashboards, and other systems of record.</li> <li>Ensure customer escalations are handled with clear ownership, appropriate executive engagement, and timely cross-functional coordination.</li> <li>Identify systemic friction in the customer journey and lead continuous-improvement initiatives that scale across EMEA and globally.</li> </ul> <h4>Build and develop an exceptional team</h4> <ul> <li>Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing CSMA and CSE leaders and practitioners across EMEA.</li> <li>Set clear expectations for customer leadership, technical depth, commercial acumen, operational discipline, and collaboration.</li> <li>Create career paths, enablement plans, mentoring programs, and succession plans for both disciplines.</li> <li>Foster an inclusive, accountable, and high-trust culture consistent with GitLab’s values and all-remote ways of working.</li> <li>Use talent, capacity, and organizational design decisions to ensure the team can support a changing portfolio and evolving product strategy.</li> </ul> <h4>Partner across the revenue and product ecosystem</h4> <ul> <li>Build trusted relationships with regional Sales and Renewal Management leaders while maintaining clear accountability for CS-owned outcomes and signals.</li> <li>Partner with Professional Services on shared customer plans, implementation-to-adoption transitions, and services attach opportunities.</li> <li>Bring structured customer insight to Product, Engineering, Support, Marketing, and Enablement.</li> <li>Orchestrate executive engagement for strategic customers and high-severity risks.</li> <li>Collaborate with global Customer Success leaders to standardize what should scale and preserve the regional adaptations that improve customer impact.</li> </ul> <h3>What success looks like</h3> <ul> <li>Customers achieve measurable outcomes and progress through their intended GitLab use cases.</li> <li>CSMA and CSE operate as one coordinated team with clear ownership, effective handoffs, and a consistent customer experience.</li> <li>Adoption, customer health, renewal risk, and expansion signals are visible, accurate, and acted on early.</li> <li>GitLab’s strategic capabilities—including Duo and the Duo Agent Platform—are adopted in ways that align to customer priorities and measurable value.</li> <li>EMEA improves time-to-value, retention health, customer advocacy, and expansion influence.</li> <li>The organization has strong leadership depth, healthy talent pipelines, and a culture of accountability and continuous learning.</li> <li>Operating metrics and forecasts are trusted by regional and global leadership.</li> </ul> <h3>What you bring</h3> <ul> <li>Significant leadership experience in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, or a related post-sales function in an enterprise SaaS or subscription software business.</li> <li>Experience leading both customer-facing relationship teams and technical customer-facing teams, ideally through managers and senior managers.</li> <li>A track record of improving customer adoption, measurable outcomes, retention, and expansion in complex enterprise accounts.</li> <li>Experience designing or scaling coverage models across dedicated, pooled, digital, or programmatic customer-success motions.</li> <li>Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management, success planning, health and risk management, adoption metrics, and renewal/expansion partnership.</li> <li>Ability to lead technical and business conversations with senior customer stakeholders, including executives, technology leaders, and engineering audiences.</li> <li>Strong operational discipline, including forecasting, capacity planning, KPI design, data quality, and inspection cadences.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to influence across Sales, Renewal Management, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, Support, and Operations.</li> <li>Experience hiring, developing, and retaining distributed teams across multiple countries and cultures.</li> <li>Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills.</li> <li>Experience with DevSecOps, software development lifecycle, developer platforms, or enterprise technology transformation.</li> <li>Experience leading adoption of AI, developer productivity, security, or platform capabilities.</li> <li>Familiarity with customer-success platforms and revenue systems such as Gainsight and Salesforce.</li> <li>Experience operating in a high-growth, global, all-remote company.</li> <li>Experience building scaled enablement programs, technical communities, or pooled specialist models.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off&nbsp;</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation &amp; Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a When a founder or an investor asks ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google how raising capital works and who to raise with, we want Pairs quoted back, and we want what gets quoted to be good. Weekly founder and company posts on LinkedIn and X, the newsletter on our site, the monthly one, and the quarterly report. You write them and you ship them. VC Content Interns you brief, edit and grow into full-time hires. Content structured so AI answer engines and journalists quote us, with share of voice tracked and SEO fundamentals underneath. You are a fit if you Have built and run a brand end to end that we can open: a named brand where you set the voice, made the content, ran the channels, and know the before and after numbers from memory. Still make it yourself. You write the posts, cut the video, direct the shoot. When we ask what you made versus what you briefed, the answer is specific. Have managed makers: a small team, freelancers, or interns, and grown at least one of them into a bigger job. Have run paid for a brand, sponsorships and retargeting included, or owned the brief and the results while someone else ran the hands. Bonus: you already live in the founder and VC corner of the internet, a personal following among founders or investors, podcast or newsletter production, on-camera comfort. title: Senior Product Manager - Subscriptions
description: Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators. The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly. This role focuses on the awareness, acquisition, and activation layers of the Subscriptions Mission, making Premium feel unmissable to free users long before a purchase decision. You'll own the strategy for how users discover, understand, and develop intent for Premium value, partnering closely with product, design, engineering, research, marketing, and data science to shape the moments, surfaces, and experiences that drive consideration across markets and segments. What You Will Do Own the product strategy and roadmap for how free users become aware of, experience, and develop intent for Premium, driving consideration, conversion intent, and subscriber growth across segments and markets. Lead the discovery, design, and delivery of subscriber-facing features from early concept through global rollout. Drive experiments that deepen our understanding of what makes users want Premium and measurably move free users closer to a purchase decision. Turn behavioral, funnel, and market data into clear hypotheses, define meaningful success metrics, and build a prioritized experimentation roadmap. Design rigorous A/B experiments to evaluate funnel changes against strong baselines, scaling approaches that demonstrably work across markets and segments. Make pragmatic trade-offs across user value, revenue impact, regional nuance, and operational complexity, knowing when a simple flow change is enough and when a deeper platform capability is needed. Partner with marketing, research, and regional teams to adapt value positioning and messaging for different markets, competitive landscapes, and user needs, including high-growth emerging markets where the path to Premium may look fundamentally different. Communicate strategy, results, and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders, translating funnel mechanics and subscription economics into business impact and strategic direction. Where You'll Be You have a strong track record in product management and have shipped consumer-facing products or features at scale, with experience that translates well to subscription, marketplace, consumer growth, or media environments. You have strong instincts for consumer value and what makes a product feel worth paying for, and understand how perception, positioning, and product experience work together to influence willingness to pay. You can break down the path from awareness to conversion, identify the highest-leverage opportunities, and connect product decisions to downstream revenue outcomes such as ARPU, LTV, and net subscriber growth. You're fluent in experimentation and A/B testing and are confident interpreting funnel, cohort, and behavioral analysis to make thoughtful prioritization decisions. You know how to navigate the complexity of a global consumer business across different segments, markets, and competitive dynamics, balancing global consistency with local relevance. You bring strong judgment about when to optimize, when to invest more deeply, and when to leave something alone, balancing user value, revenue impact, and operational cost. You're a clear communicator and collaborative partner across product, design, engineering, marketing, research, data science, and regional teams, and you can align people around shared outcomes. You're comfortable working through open-ended problems, learning quickly through experimentation, and adapting your approach based on evidence. Where You Will Be This role is based in London, United Kingdom or Stockholm, Sweden. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

***

THE KEY BITS

  • Location: We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located and have long-term working rights in the UK.

  • Flexibility: We operate a choice-first work approach that lets you work fully remotely from Day One even if you’re near an office hub.

  • Salary: We've benchmarked this interim role at £800-1,000/day for the ~8-month contract for someone based in the UK. This is equivalent to an MN3 (Director) level in our progression framework.

  • Interviews: 3 stages totalling around 2.5 hours over 2 weeks.

  • Start date / duration: 19 Oct, 2026 - May 28, 2027

  • Reporting to: Richard Mabey, CEO

  • Direct reports: Charlotte (Financial Controller) + Irina (Finance Ops Associate)

  • More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers, our handbook or ask ----- anything.

HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER

Juro has big ambitions: to become the go-to platform for agreeing and managing contracts globally. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

Eimear (our Director of Finance) is heading off on maternity leave, and we're looking for an interim Finance Director to hold the seat for ~8 months (October to May).

This isn't a caretaker role, and it isn't a pure people-leadership role either. You're a player-coach in FP&A, meaning you’ll:

  • personally run the FY27 FP&A cycle end-to-end,

  • partner with other execs as a peer to shape strategy, and

  • coach a Financial Controller and an Analyst on everything else.

Success means:

  1. Own and run the FY27 FP&A cycle end-to-end: budget, monthly reforecast, board packs, monthly exec business reviews.

  2. Partner with the CEO and exec team as a peer, shaping board and investor reporting and influencing strategic finance decisions as they arise.

  3. Lead the finance team, with an active coaching load on month-end.

We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

WHO WE LOOK FOR

  • You've worked in a B2B SaaS company for a significant part of the last 2 years.

  • You've personally run a full FP&A cycle end-to-end (budget, reforecasts, board reporting), not just contributed to one someone else owned.

  • You're accounting-literate and can support and challenge a controller, even if you're not the one closing the books.

  • You've been the finance owner in a diligence process. That means you've built the data room and held numbers up under external scrutiny.

  • You've partnered directly with execs and a board; not just reporting numbers to them, but shaping and influencing their decisions.

  • You've led a small finance team.

  • You've been hands-on and energised by rolling up your sleeves.

This job likely isn't for you if:

  • You need time and coaching to grow into the role; we need someone who can land running, our CEO won’t have the time to train you.

  • You'd rather direct than build.

  • High-stakes corporate moments (transactions, diligence, board scrutiny) are unfamiliar territory.

  • You've never partnered with execs or led a team.

  • Your FP&A experience is "supporting" rather than owning.

OUR MISSION

Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

Frustrated by the absurdly slow process of taking a contract from inception through to agreement, Juro co-founders Richard and Pavel thought there must be a better way. They set out in 2016 to build a flexible, collaborative platform that anyone could use to process a legal contract end-to-end in their browser.

Fast forward 8 years and we have helped our customers process 2 million contracts in over 85 countries. Some of the world’s fastest-growing businesses, like Deliveroo, Remote, and Trustpilot have relied on Juro to help them streamline routine contracts at scale across multiple years of their growth.

But our story is just beginning.‍ Read more about our vision for intelligent contract automation.

title: Engineering Manager - DevOps & AI Platform
description: Do you want to lead the engineering functions that decide how a platform screening over a billion dollars of crypto transactions every week is built and run? Are you a DevOps leader fascinated by the possibilities of both agentic software solutions and the usage of agents in the software delivery lifecycle? Are you looking for a values-led company that cares about the growth of its people as much as the strength of its platform? Elliptic is where ambitious people do the most important work of their careers. We are making crypto safe, secure and scalable, preventing global financial crime, exposing bad actors and protecting the world's financial system as it is being revolutionized. This is work your friends will actually want to hear about. You can expect to work in highly empowered teams, with remarkable breadth and the freedom to turn bold ideas into real impact, supported every step of the way by some of the most brilliant people you have ever called colleagues. The impact you will have: This role provides the people leadership for two connected functions at the heart of how Elliptic engineers. On the DevOps side, you keep a latency-sensitive screening platform dependable, cost-effective and scalable as transaction volume and customer expectations grow. On the AI Platform side, you lead the team that acts as Elliptic's centre of excellence for building AI agents, owning the shared frameworks, patterns, MCP management and evaluation capability that every product team draws on. You are a two-way conduit for that centre of excellence: carrying its best practice out to teams, and helping define what those best approaches should be. Reliability remains foundational to everything Elliptic does, and you will champion strong SRE practices across the business, though the SRE function itself sits outside your direct people-management scope. This is a hands-off, strategy and people-leadership role: you lead and grow the people, set the operating model, and make the calls that shape DevOps and AI Platform at Elliptic. What you will do: Lead, grow and develop the people across two functions, DevOps and AI Platform, owning hiring, levelling, coaching and career development for a combined team of roughly twelve engineers. Set the strategy and operating model for DevOps: release safety, developer experience, observability, cost and the scalability of a latency-sensitive screening platform. Lead the AI Platform function as a centre of excellence, owning the people and operating model behind Elliptic's shared agent-building frameworks and patterns, MCP management, evaluation framework and shared AI infrastructure. Act as a two-way conduit for the centre of excellence: disseminate best practice and reusable approaches out to product teams building their own agents, and channel their feedback back to define and improve those approaches. Partner with the AI Platform technical lead and senior engineers to shape technical direction, bringing people leadership and delivery rather than owning the technical vision single-handedly. Own the cost, scalability and efficiency of the infrastructure as volume grows, bringing a FinOps mindset to infrastructure spend. Champion SRE and reliability practices across the business, partnering closely with the SRE function. Support the infrastructure and process maturity needed for certifications such as ISO 27001 and SOC2, working with InfoSec. What you will achieve in the first 6 months: Built trust across both functions and their counterparts, and developed a clear, evidence-based picture of the platform's reliability and cost posture and of how the AI Platform centre of excellence currently works and shares knowledge. Shaped and begun executing a people and hiring strategy across both functions, growing DevOps toward its target and building out the AI Platform and AI infrastructure team. Begun operating as an effective conduit for the centre of excellence, strengthening how agent-building best practice, MCP and evaluation approaches are defined centrally and adopted by product teams. Established a clear point of view on AI SDLC and how the platform enables it, and championed SRE practices across the business. You will be a great fit here if you: Lead through people: you measure your success by the growth and impact of your team, not your own output. Are credible with senior engineers without needing to be the hands-on expert: you ask the sharp question and facilitate the right decision. Are genuinely curious about AI, agents and evaluations, and energised by helping an organisation learn to build with them well. Are honest and pragmatic about timelines and trade-offs, and comfortable owning a long-term build-out across two functions. Care about the mission: providing the infrastructure and intelligence that keep financial institutions safe from crypto crime and sanctions evasion. Our ideal candidate has: A track record of managing DevOps, platform or infrastructure engineers, including hiring and building a growing team. An infrastructure background (cloud, IaC, CI/CD, observability) deep enough to make sound strategic calls and guide senior engineers toward the right ones. Extreme curiosity about AI and budding hands-on experience with AI, agents and evaluations: not necessarily deep expertise, but a real, demonstrated pull toward the space and the judgement to grow into leading it. A strong interest in the nuances of the AI-assisted SDLC, and the conviction that tooling alone does not make engineers more potent. Adoption, practice and guardrails are what turn AI access into real leverage. Kubernetes literacy, grounded in hands-on experience as an engineer, sufficient to reason about the estate and challenge the team's decisions. AI fluency: candidates must be able to demonstrate practical, responsible use of AI in an engineering context and the ability to set team norms for it. We are looking for an active AI promoter who can reason about where AI adds leverage and where it is a liability in a compliance setting. Bonus Points for: Experience leading or building an internal platform, ML platform, developer-experience or enablement function. Hands-on exposure to agent frameworks, MCP, or building and running evaluation frameworks. Experience of a company scaling phase. Exposure to ISO 27001 / SOC2 and what they demand of infrastructure and process. Experience with high-throughput, low-latency systems in a regulated or financial context. HODLs Crypto. Job Benefits > How we work: Hybrid working and the option to work from almost anywhere for up to 90 days per year £500 Remote working budget to set up your home office space > Learning & Development: $1,000 Learning & Development budget to use on anything (agreed with your manager) that contributes to your growth and development > Vacation/ Leave: Holidays: 25 days of annual leave + bank holidays An extra day for your birthday Enhanced parental leave: we provide eligible employees, regardless of gender or whether they become a parent by birth or adoption, 16 weeks fully-paid leave and leave. > Benefits: Private Health Insurance - we use Bupa! Full access to Spill Mental Health Support Life Assurance: we hope you will never need this - but our cover is for 4 times your salary to your beneficiaries Cycle to Work Scheme Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

  • Own the prioritised order of work for Core — building a clear, ranked plan, explaining the reasoning behind it, and being explicit about what's being deferred and why

  • Turn vague or incomplete partner requests into documented problems, mapped current-state processes, and testable outcomes

  • Partner directly and regularly with People Operations, Compliance, Payroll, Total Rewards and Business Systems Analysts, including holding "not now" conversations without damaging the relationship

  • Work hands-on with analysts and engineers to shape, size, and write tickets, keeping an accurate and current picture of committed, shipped, and carried-over work

  • Use AI tools to accelerate translation of messy, multi-format, multi-language inbound requests into structured requirements and plans, while applying clear judgment about what should never be automated (anything touching pay, leave, employment status or right to work)

  • Escalate proactively on statutory or audit exposure, cross-space dependencies, and any trade-off that would move a compliance date

  • Report progress and delivery against plan to partners and leadership, including clear communication when outcomes fall short

Requirements

  • Experience owning a product or systems area end-to-end, with real decision rights over scope and sequencing — not co-ownership of a feature

  • Hands-on background with Workday or a comparable HRIS as a product manager or technical program manager, with genuine understanding of configuration, business processes, and integrations

  • Demonstrated ability to prioritise when demand structurally exceeds capacity, including a repeatable method (not just instinct) for deciding what to do and communicating what won't get done

  • Proven delivery in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, comfortable starting when requirements are incomplete or undocumented

  • Experience translating a partner's requested solution into a well-defined problem, current-state understanding, and testable outcome

  • The bar, full stop - if it ships under the Siena name, you made it or you signed off on it

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, articulating clear business value, ROI, and risk reduction while building long-term, influential partnerships across your accounts.

This role is focused on new account acquisition and strategic account expansion, managing sophisticated, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from initial engagement through contract negotiation, close, and post-sale alignment. You will carry annual and quarterly targets and operate as a core member of the revenue organization.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and Execute Account & Territory Strategy

  • Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans aligned to revenue targets and long-term growth objectives

  • Identify high-value target accounts and prioritize opportunities based on market potential, customer maturity, and strategic fit

  • Build and maintain accurate pipeline forecasts and revenue plans

Strategic Relationship Building

  • Build and expand executive-level relationships across assigned accounts, engaging stakeholders from site level through C-suite

  • Identify and develop decision-makers, champions, influencers, and economic buyers

  • Establish XYZ Reality as a strategic partner, not just a technology vendor

Consultative & Value-Based Selling

  • Lead with a consultative selling approach, deeply understanding customer challenges, delivery risk, and commercial drivers

  • Translate customer pain points into compelling business cases that clearly demonstrate value, ROI, and operational impact

  • Align XYZ Reality’s AR solution to customer objectives across safety, quality, schedule, and cost control

Manage Complex Sales Cycles

  • Own the end-to-end sales process: prospecting, qualification, solution alignment, commercial negotiation, and close

  • Navigate complex deal structures, including enterprise-level negotiations, procurement processes, and contractual requirements

  • Support and respond to RFPs / formal bid processes where required, partnering closely with internal stakeholders

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing, SDRs, Revenue Operations, Professional Services, and Delivery teams to drive new business and expansion

  • Partner internally to align technical solutions, services strategy, and commercial structures to customer needs

  • Ensure smooth handoff from sales to implementation and ongoing account success

Partner & Ecosystem Engagement

  • Collaborate with construction partners, consultants, and industry stakeholders to drive co-selling opportunities

  • Leverage partner relationships to strengthen account strategy and accelerate deal velocity

Market & Competitive Intelligence

  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitor activity, and market dynamics within mission-critical construction

  • Provide feedback to leadership on product positioning, customer insights, and evolving market needs

Sales Operations & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Salesforce, including opportunities, forecasts, and next steps

  • Analyse sales data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for optimization

You Could Be a Strong Candidate If You Have:

  • Proven experience owning complex, enterprise sales cycles with annual quotas

  • Track record of closing 6-figure+ deals with multiple stakeholders and long decision cycles

  • Strong experience in value-based and solution selling, including account planning and strategic execution

  • Excellent communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences

  • CRM discipline and comfort operating in structured sales processes

The Ideal Candidate:

  • Experience selling into mission-critical construction environments (data centre, pharma, semiconductor, nuclear, oil & gas)

  • Background in construction technology, SaaS, or cloud-based solutions

  • Comfortable engaging senior executives while also operating on site and with delivery teams

  • Proactive, coachable, and energized by building long-term customer relationships

  • Willing and able to travel domestically and internationally for meetings and demos

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

What we're looking for

As a Backend Engineer, you’ll design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performing backend systems that power our innovative products. You’ll collaborate with a talented team to create solutions that drive financial inclusion and transform the way people manage their money.

What you'll be doing

  • The work will focus on greenfield development and improvement of existing systems

  • Projects will include building REST APIs, engineering microservices and evolving a number of systems that our business depends on (e.g. card payments, treasury management, transactions booking, crypto liquidity)

  • Our technology stack is based predominantly on Java 25 on the backend with Postgres database

  • We rely on Spring Boot for quick and quality delivery

  • We have a pragmatic approach to develop our business logic, focusing on clean code, with emphasis on maintainability and fast turnaround with TDD, DDD and continuous integration & delivery

What you'll need

  • Demonstrable experience in Backend development, with fluency in Java

  • Bachelor's Degree (or above) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or other Engineering / Science disciplines

  • Quick learner with an ambitious and results driven personality, with excellent communication skills (english fluency, verbal and written)

  • Track record of building complex products that millions of people use in hypergrowth startups

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits

  • Stock options, so you own part of what you build

  • Discretionary performance bonus

  • The latest tools and technology

  • A world-class team that will challenge and grow your skills

  • The opportunity to help build the best fintech app in Latin America

  • Office Policy: 3-4 days a week in-office

Cavalry officers must be able to ride horses. What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s a dose of the kind of things you’ll be doing:

  • Build and guide a high-performing, cross-functional engineering team. Foster a culture where engineers feel motivated, empowered, and proud of the impact they create.

  • Stay engaged with technical design, code reviews, and architectural decisions, setting a high bar for technical excellence while balancing leadership responsibilities.

PUR Description 

PUR is a global B Corp helping companies act for climate, nature and people through nature-based projects. 

Since 2008, we have worked with leading companies to restore ecosystems, support farmers and communities, and build more resilient supply chains. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries. 

We work closely with local partners, farmers, cooperatives, NGOs and businesses to design projects that are adapted to each landscape and community. This local approach is key to creating long-term impact — for the climate, biodiversity, soil, water, and livelihoods. 

Today, PUR has more than 200 team members across 16 countries, with key offices in Paris and Toronto. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action. 

 

About the role 

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data processing solutions that power analytics, reporting, and data-driven decision making. You will play a key role in transforming raw project data into reliable, high-quality datasets through robust ETL processes, modern data architectures, and Python-based engineering practices. 

Working closely with business and technical stakeholders, you will ensure that data is accessible, trustworthy, and aligned with analytical requirements while contributing to the continuous improvement of our data platform and cloud-based ecosystem. 

 

Your responsibilities will be, but not limited to: 

 

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python.

  • Build and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and validation processes for large datasets.

  • Design and maintain data models supporting reporting, analytics, and business applications.

  • Implement and monitor data quality controls to ensure reliability and accuracy.

  • Manage and optimize workflows using orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of cloud-based data platforms (preferably Azure).

  • Support CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform).

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and reliable data solutions.

  • Maintain technical documentation and promote data engineering best practices.


We are looking for someone with: 

  • 3-5 years of experience in Data Engineering, with strong Python skills and experience building production-grade ETL pipelines.

  • Strong SQL expertise and solid understanding of relational and analytical databases, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster) and implementing automated testing for data pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform is a strong plus).

  • Familiarity with AI tools (Claude is a plus).

  • Strong knowledge of Git and software engineering best practices.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, focus on data quality and reliability, and ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.

  1. Interview with the recruiter

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, race, gender, colour, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or any other aspect that makes them unique.
