description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership. You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team , whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost. Why is this role interesting? High-impact scope : You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers. Real ownership : You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery. Builder's playground : You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale. Tangible results : Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate. What will you do with us? You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works. You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks. ⭐ Is it you we're looking for? Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona. For this role we are looking to hire within the D-E level range . Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team. 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible office with hybrid setup . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona. All the tools you need . Generous transit benefit Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture . Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people, not roles.   • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have full working proficiency in French and at least an advanced level in English.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Business Segment Lead role ⭐️

At Alan, we split the French market in several business segments, each of them corresponding to a category of clients (whether by size, or industry).

The role of a Business Segment Lead is to reach market leadership in their given segment. To succeed, you will have to (1) articulate a vision for your segment, (2) define priorities and resources to deliver, and (3) make strategic decisions for your segment based on market insights.

The Business Segment Lead role is made for transversal influence as we operate based on distributed ownership. You will work closely with all teams involved in the success of your segment (Product, Insurance, Sales, Marketing). You will also collaborate with other segment leaders to build-up knowledge, share best practices, and create alignment around a long-term value plan.

Main missions include:

  • Market intelligence: You’ll build expertise on our market and competitive landscape. You’ll work both on the quantitative side (sizing) and the qualitative side (customers’ pain points and needs).

  • Value proposition and pricing: Our goal is to differentiate our offer from the market. You’ll relentlessly ask yourself: what is the best product offering to become leader in this segment?

  • Go-to-Market strategy: You’ll work both on renewal (account management) and expansion strategy (business development). This will require you to adapt and innovate when it comes to distribution channels, sub-segments, and partners management.

  • P&L ownership & Resources allocation: You’ll own the return on investment of your segment and are in charge of building the case for internal resources allocation based on your P&L.

  • Product trade-off: You’ll work together with product teams in order for us to build the best product based on market insights.

We are currently hiring for new segments:

  • It gathers several, high potential sub-segments where everything is to be built.

  • We will focus heavily on those new opportunities in the coming years.

⭐️ If you have some of the following, you may be a great fit ⭐️

  • At least 8 years of prior experience leading a business (product category, business segment, etc.)

  • Full working proficiency in French

  • At least advanced level in English

  • An exceptional ability to establish transversal influence

  • Used to analyze and manipulate data to build a 360 degree view of your market

  • A strong business sense while being able to go deep into product considerations

  • Able to articulate clear strategies in spite of complexity/uncertainty

  • A prior experience working with senior leadership

  • You are a generalist self-starter (Vs a specialist of 1 single industry) able to adapt fast and not afraid to go on the field to support your team mates and learn from them

  • You are based in (or willing to relocate to) either Paris, Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role, we are looking to hire within the E-F level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Mission

Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite.

Scope

⚙️ Platform & automation

  • Own and extend automations on Alan Home, our internal provisioning engine

  • Maintain, extend and improve helpdesk automation, SaaS provisioning flows, and onboarding/offboarding pipelines

  • Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices

🔑 Identity & access

  • Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, mobility between jobs and countries) across Google Workspace, SSO/SAML and our SaaS ecosystem.

  • Grow our role-based access model: extend it to more tools and refine the permission groups, so access is granted by role rather than case by case

  • Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end

  • Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on

  • Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack

🔒 Endpoint & SaaS security

  • Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance

  • Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls

  • Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope

🩺 Health Professionals IT

  • The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access

  • Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process

🌍 Internationalisation

  • Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one

  • Bring acquired entities onto that same platform

  • Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

  • Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment

  • Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

First 6 months

  • Own a workstream end-to-end, with an IT Ops teammate working alongside you

  • Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end

  • Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it

  • Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

First year

  • Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope

  • Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it

  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit)

  • Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates

3 years

  • Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities

  • Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains

  • Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work

description: Participe à notre journée exceptionnelle de recrutement pour rejoindre notre Sales Graduate Program chez Alan ! Tu es diplômé(e) d'un Master avec maximum 2 ans d'expérience et tu souhaites débuter ta carrière dans la vente ? Le jeudi 8 Octobre 2026 , Alan t’invite à une journée de recrutement exclusive dans nos bureaux parisiens. Saisis ta chance de lancer ta carrière en tant que Business Development Representative (BDR) dès Janvier 2027 (ou selon tes disponibilités) , d’acquérir des bases solides en vente, et de tracer ta voie vers des rôles Sales seniors chez Alan en 18 à 24 mois ! Pourquoi participer ? Vis une expérience unique & décroche ta place dans notre Sales Graduate Program : un véritable tremplin pour propulser ta carrière dans la vente. Plonge dans l’univers d’Alan : découvre notre vision et notre ambition au contact direct de nos Alaners. Bénéficie d’un process rapide & transparent : avec une réponse sous 48h à l’issue de la journée. Plonge au cœur du métier de BDR chez Alan : découvre concrètement ce rôle à travers des mises en situation et des échanges privilégiés avec l’équipe. Le processus de recrutement : 📅 Date de l’événement : Jeudi 8 Octobre 2026 📍 Lieu : Siège d’Alan : 117 Quai de Valmy, 75010 Paris ⏰ Date limite de candidature : Jeudi 1 Octobre 2026 📈 Les étapes : Nous étudions toutes les candidatures reçues pour sélectionner les meilleurs profils. Si ton profil est retenu, nous t’appellerons pour t’annoncer la nouvelle et échanger brièvement sur tes motivations. Tu recevras un cas pratique à réaliser chez toi : des questions de motivation et un pitch vidéo à enregistrer. Les candidat(e)s retenu(e)s seront invité(e)s à rejoindre notre journée exclusive au siège d’Alan, avec au programme une étude de cas et des entretiens. À l’issue de cette journée, nous donnons notre réponse en 48h, et les profils sélectionnés rejoindront l’aventure Alan au sein de notre Sales Graduate Program à partir de Janvier 2027 ! ⭐️ Tout savoir sur notre Sales Graduate Program Le principe ? Sur une période de 18 à 24 mois , nous t’offrons l'opportunité d'évoluer au sein du rôle de Business Development Representative (BDR) en acquérant progressivement des compétences plus avancées dans la vente. Phase 1 : Apprends les bases du métier de BDR : prospection, compréhension du marché, création d’opportunités, échanges avec des décideurs. Phase 2 : Développe ton leadership : en tant que BDR, prends des responsabilités transverses telles que le recrutement, le coaching des nouveaux, l’animation de formations et la gestion de projets. Phase 3 : Spécialise-toi : concentre-toi soit sur la prospection des grands comptes (plus complexes et stratégiques), soit sur les PME, en menant des rendez-vous de découverte et des démonstrations produit. Cette progression au sein du rôle de BDR te permettra de développer des compétences commerciales complètes qui te prépareront à une future mobilité interne en tant qu'Account Executive ou Inbound Sales. Envie d’en savoir plus sur le Sales Graduate Program ? 👉 Découvre les coulisses de la première promotion ici 👉 Découvre l'équipe en vidéo ici 👉 Découvre comment on a conçu le programme ici 👉 Lis le témoignage inspirant de Diane sur pourquoi la prospection est un art stratégique 👉 Explore notre approche unique de la vente 💥 Es-tu notre candidat idéal ? Chez Alan, notre devise est "nous recrutons des personnes, pas des rôles" : nous valorisons les compétences interpersonnelles plus que techniques. Nous croyons que ton potentiel est ce qui compte vraiment. Tu seras un bon fit pour rejoindre l'équipe Sales d'Alan si : Tu détiens un Master d'une école de commerce, avec jusqu'à deux ans d'expérience professionnelle ; Tu montres un intérêt fort pour la vente, et détiens idéalement une première expérience dans ce domaine Tu es enthousiaste, animé(e) par notre mission, et désireux(se) de partager notre ambition ; Tu es team player, organisé(e), et capable de gérer plusieurs tâches simultanément ; Tu es désireux(se) d'apprendre et de grandir dans de nouveaux rôles ; Tu es basé(e) à (ou prêt(e) à déménager à) Paris ou Bordeaux Prêt(e) à rejoindre notre Business Development Representative - Graduate Program ? Pour cette opportunité, nous visons à recruter dans la fourchette de niveau A2-B0 . 🐼 Qui sommes-nous ? La vision d'Alan est de faire de la prévention la nouvelle norme de soin pour tous. Notre mission est d'aider les gens à vivre en bonne santé jusqu'à 100 ans tout en aidant les employeurs à être fiers, transformant les avantages santé d'un centre de coûts en leur investissement le plus précieux. Nous construisons un partenaire santé intégré qui unit harmonieusement assurance et prestations de soins intelligentes en un seul système. En connectant tous les aspects du soin - privé, public et direct consommateur - nous créons une expérience santé centrée sur nos membres. Grâce à un engagement profond, nous donnons à chacun les moyens de surmonter les obstacles de santé du quotidien et de vivre plus sainement. 🚀 Comment on s'y prend ? Les personnes qui rejoignent Alan sont souvent surprises et ravies par notre méthode de travail innovante. Nous avons un ensemble de valeurs culturelles qui guident notre approche du travail : La mission est notre priorité — Nous pensons à long terme et sommes des optimistes méthodiques qui prenons des risques, recherchant avant tout la réussite de notre mission. Responsabilité partagée — Chacun est responsable de ses décisions et de ses résultats. Transparence radicale — Toutes les informations sont accessibles et consignées par écrit, afin que chacun puisse prendre les meilleures décisions de manière asynchrone. En constante évolution — Du feedback direct, positif et bienveillant, associé à une prise en charge de son propre développement personnel. 🙌 Avantages & Bénéfices Chez Alan, nous croyons qu' être en bonne santé est un besoin fondamental, et cela commence avec nos employés. C'est pourquoi les Alaners bénéficient d'un environnement stimulant et d'avantages garantissant qu'ils sont heureux, efficaces et ne passent que du temps de qualité avec leurs collègues. Par conséquent, nous offrons : Récompenses équitables . Des packages d'equity généreux complètent ton salaire de base. Bureau flexible . Espace de bureau incroyable dans notre HQ à Paris ou hub de co-working sponsorisé à Bordeaux. Tous les outils dont tu as besoin . Équipement haut de gamme : Macbook Pro, clavier, support laptop, écran, et casque anti-bruit. Politique de vacances flexible et horaires de travail flexibles . Organise ton temps comme tu le souhaites. Assurance santé complète - prise en charge à 100% pour toi et tes enfants, 90-100% pour les partenaires selon ton pays (contrats permanents uniquement) . Transport . Avantages de transport spécifiques au pays. Opportunités d'apprentissage et de formation. Politique de formation très flexible, livres gratuits et budget pour assister et parler lors de conférences si l'opportunité se présente. Croissance personnelle par le coaching : Chez Alan, le coaching n'est pas juste un avantage - c'est au cœur de qui nous sommes. Chaque Alaner est accompagné par un coach dédié dès le premier jour, qui aide à maximiser son impact, nourrir l'engagement, et naviguer les valeurs d'Alan pour développer son plein potentiel. Congé parental. Congé parental étendu pour tous les nouveaux parents. Note importante : nous recrutons des personnes, pas des rôles. Si tu es intéressé(e) par cette opportunité mais ne coches pas toutes les cases, nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles. Tout le monde devrait se sentir libre de postuler car cela ne peut qu'apporter apprentissages ou succès. Si tu t'identifies comme une femme : Savais-tu que les recherches montrent que les femmes postulent souvent, uniquement, quand elles remplissent 100% des exigences ? Rappelle-toi, c'est juste un guide, pas une checklist. Nous serons ravis de recevoir ta candidature ! 🔖 Consulte nos pages À propos d'Alan , Medium et Carrières , ainsi que notre blog et page Glassdoor pour plus d'infos. IT at Alan is not a helpdesk. Run and support take roughly 60% of your time; the rest goes to build projects you co-own with the IT Engineer leading them.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. We staff people according to their strengths and interests, and it evolves over time.

Scope

🛟 Support & Oncall

  • Own L1/L2 oncall for 900+ Alaners across 5+ countries, with a clear escalation path to engineers

  • Triage, communicate to users during incidents, and escalate appropriately

  • Document recurring issues and reduce ticket volume through self-service

💻 Device lifecycle & endpoint compliance

  • Own the full device lifecycle: procurement, zero-touch enrollment (Apple Business Manager, Kandji), repair, retrieval

  • Maintain role-based Kandji blueprints and least-privilege configurations

  • Contribute to device compliance across all countries (MDM, EDR, FileVault) and to audit evidence

  • Own the physical side: laptop locker, hardware inventory, office equipment

  • Take over day-to-day device operations as we bring them back in-house from our outsourced provider

🔑 Identity, access & SaaS platforms

  • Own onboarding and offboarding end-to-end, across both automated and manually-managed tools

  • Administer Google Workspace, SSO/SAML, licences and access reviews

  • Manage day-to-day vendor relationships and procurement on your scope

⚙️ Build

  • Co-own a build project alongside the IT Engineer who leads it

  • Examples from the current roadmap: rebuilding the onboarding intake, the meeting room audiovisual equipment and room-booking revamp, the IT playbook for new offices, ISO 27001 / ACPR evidence collection

  • Ship automation and self-service tooling that measurably reduces IT toil

Milestones

First 2 months

  • Join IT oncall rotation (helpdesk) with buddy/shadowing support

  • Discover Alan's processes, stack (Kandji, Apple Business Manager), SaaS ecosystem, and identity tools (Google Workspace, SSO, Alan Home)

  • Handle most typical IT operations issues autonomously (equipment, SaaS access, account provisioning)

First 6 months

  • Handle IT oncall shifts autonomously, solving most problems that do not require engineer input

  • Own onboarding/offboarding workflows end-to-end

  • Have wide knowledge of Alan's processes, equipment, and tools

  • Contribute to a build project alongside an IT Engineer

First year

  • Be regarded as an expert on at least one topic beyond the oncall rotation (e.g. MDM, SaaS admin, compliance documentation)

  • Contribute on device compliance improvements (MDM, EDR, FileVault) across all countries

  • Ship automation or self-service projects that measurably reduce IT toil, with limited guidance

  • Lead small to medium IT projects end-to-end

3 years

  • Fully autonomous on the User Experience & Platform workstreams

  • Lead medium to high-complexity IT projects end-to-end

  • Mentor newer team members, reduce bus factor through documentation, automation and knowledge sharing

What we're looking for

Must-have - Technical/hard skills:

  • 1-3 years in IT operations (or strong internship / student association background in a tech environment): device management (MDM, ideally Kandji), SaaS administration, basic identity & access management (Google Workspace, SSO)

  • Operational reflexes: can triage issues, communicate to users during incidents, and escalate appropriately. Has oncall or production support experience

  • Automation & AI appetite: scripting basics (Python, Bash) or low-code, and an instinct for what should be automated or delegated to AI rather than repeated

  • Documentation mindset: writes clear, structured documentation

  • Learning velocity: Picks up new tools and processes quickly.

Must-have - Behavioral / soft skills:

  • Delivers with attention to detail: handles run tasks reliably and consistently

  • Raises questions and identifies frictions: spots problems, flags them, and suggests improvements

  • Service orientation: cares about the Alaner experience, and is comfortable proposing a better solution than the one asked for

  • Cross-team collaboration: partners effectively with Workplace, Security, People and Engineering; explains technical topics clearly to non-technical stakeholders

  • Proactive: Identifies what needs doing and proposes next steps (with guidance where needed)

Nice-to-have skills / Bonus points if you have:

  • macOS fluency: comfortable troubleshooting macOS, understands the Apple ecosystem (Apple Business Manager, DEP enrollment)

  • Experience with Kandji specifically

  • Exposure to security compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HDS), even just awareness

  • SaaS vendor management and/or license administration

  • Interest in automation and coding (even from college/school projects)

  • Experience in a fast-growing, multi-country tech company

Languages: Fluent French & Professional English

Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France.

 

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

title: Account Executive - French Speaking
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive - French Speaking based in France. As an Account Executive, you will turn qualified product demonstrations into new, active, and transacting customers within a fast-growing global B2B marketplace. You will own the full commercial journey from discovery and demo through negotiation, contract closure, compliance, onboarding, and early customer activation. Beyond closing deals, you will be responsible for helping customers establish strong purchasing habits during their first 90 days. You will work closely with SDRs and Account Managers to ensure seamless handoffs and a strong customer experience. The role combines consultative selling, commercial negotiation, operational follow-through, and account activation. You will join a globally distributed sales organization where ownership, speed, customer relationships, and measurable results are highly valued. Accountabilities Run discovery-led product demonstrations that connect the marketplace's capabilities to each retailer's specific purchasing workflow, business needs, and commercial objectives. Manage the full sales cycle from proposal and commercial terms through objection handling, stakeholder alignment, negotiation, and contract closure. Build trusted relationships with prospective customers and clearly communicate the value of broader supplier access, competitive pricing, product selection, and marketplace efficiency. Drive KYC and compliance processes through to completion, proactively following up on documentation and resolving onboarding obstacles without losing sales momentum. Own the customer journey throughout the first 90 days, helping new accounts move from initial searches and quotations to their first orders and repeat purchases. Focus on customer activation and long-term value rather than simply closing and handing off newly signed accounts. Partner with SDRs to ensure strong qualification and effective handoffs before and after demonstrations. Coordinate with Account Managers to provide detailed account context, purchasing patterns, opportunities, and potential risks ahead of the day-90 transition. Maintain accurate pipeline stages, activity records, and forecasts, ensuring commercial reporting reflects the true state of opportunities. Monitor and improve key performance indicators including demo-to-close conversion, new business revenue, KYC completion time, 90-day activation, account value, and forecast accuracy. Requirements 3–6 years of proven experience in a closing sales role, ideally within a marketplace, transactional B2B/B2C platform, or the jewellery and diamond industry with meaningful commercial exposure. Strong understanding of marketplace dynamics, including liquidity, supply breadth, customer trust, transaction mechanics, and the importance of driving an initial transaction to establish long-term purchasing behaviour. Experience selling solutions based on customer workflows and business outcomes rather than relying on feature-led product presentations. Excellent discovery, presentation, demonstration, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills. Commercially minded and comfortable managing pricing discussions, contractual terms, and pushback from customers and multiple stakeholders. Strong operational discipline and willingness to own post-sale activities such as KYC, compliance, onboarding, and activation. Ability to manage a pipeline effectively, prioritize opportunities, and maintain accurate forecasts in a fast-paced environment. Customer-focused approach with the ability to build credible, long-term relationships with businesses of different sizes. Strong ownership, resilience, adaptability, and attention to detail, with the ability to maintain momentum across multiple deals and customer journeys. Excellent communication skills in French and English , with the ability to communicate confidently with international customers and internal stakeholders. Comfortable working independently in a globally distributed, low-hierarchy environment where initiative and measurable impact are highly valued. Benefits Flexible working hours designed to support autonomy and effective performance. Fully remote working environment. Unlimited holiday allowance. With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. The Team

  • An international team (with more than 38 nationalities) with complementary education and experience in investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational sectors
  • Composed of alumni from: INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, ESSEC, Imperial College, Dartmouth, etc.
  • Professional backgrounds: Private Equity, Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), MandA (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC), Industry

Requirements

Location: Lyon, France

Contract: Permanent (CDI)

As part of ARCHIMED's Information Systems Department (ISD), reporting directly to our Data/AI Manager, you will drive the development and deployment of Artificial Intelligence solutions across the firm. Acting as the bridge between technical teams, business stakeholders, and the Data/AI leadership, you will ensure that AI initiatives are delivered with strategic alignment, operational rigor, and measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities

1.       Product Development and Strategic Alignment

·       Collaborate on defining the product vision and roadmap for AI initiatives, in close alignment with firm priorities.

·       Translate & challenge business needs into clear, actionable product requirements and user stories

·       Ensure AI solutions deliver measurable value and are adopted effectively across business lines

 

2.        Backlog Management

·       Own, prioritize and continuously refine the product backlog in collaboration with business & development teams

·       Ensure delivery cadence is maintained and risks are proactively escalated

3.        Business Partnering and Change Management

·       Act as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, gathering needs, managing expectations and driving adoption

·       Support business teams in understanding AI capabilities and in defining use cases with high ROI potential

·       Lead change management efforts to ensure smooth integration of AI tools into existing workflows

·       Manage & develop support materials

 

4.       AI Expertise and Innovation

·       Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of AI/ML trends, tools and best practices relevant to company’s needs

·       Evaluate new AI solutions and vendors, providing informed recommendations to the ISD leadership

·       Ensure responsible AI principles (explainability, fairness, data privacy …) throughout product development & usage

 

5.       Coordination and Governance

·       Coordinate cross-functional teams (Compliance, Cyber, Business) to ensure end-to-end delivery

·       Define and monitor KPIs to track product performance and adoption

·       Contribute to AI governance frameworks, documentation standards and reporting to senior stakeholders

 

 

 

Profile and Qualifications

·       Education: Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business or a related field

·       Experience: Minimum 5 years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, with at least one significant AI or data-driven product deployment

·       Solid understanding of AI, data pipelines and modern development methodologies  & technologies

·       Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into business language and vice versa

·       Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience working across technical and non-technical teams

·       Analytical mindset with a structured, problem-solving approach

·       Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (French is a plus)

·       Experience in financial services, private equity or healthcare is a plus

Biggie est un groupe de conseil en communication, né de la fusion de l’agence média Repeat, du trading desk Gamned!, du studio de création vidéo Kazam et de l’agence en stratégie d’influence Beastly.
 
Comprenant 300 collaborateurs et des filiales dans de nombreux pays (France, Belgique, Suisse, Italie, République Tchèque, Emirats Arabes Unis, Brésil…), le groupe s’appuie sur sa capacité à fédérer l’excellence, via l’intégration d’expertises publicitaires leader de leur marché, de manière à concevoir et piloter des stratégies de communication 360 à l'échelle l’internationale.

🗒️ Missions

1. Audit & Optimisation Salesforce

  • Réaliser un audit complet de l’environnement Salesforce : architecture, configuration, automatisations, données, sécurité, reporting et usages.
  • Identifier les dysfonctionnements, risques, points de friction et opportunités d’amélioration.
  • Évaluer l’adéquation de Salesforce avec les processus et besoins métiers.
  • Formuler des recommandations fonctionnelles et techniques et identifier les quick wins.

2. Data, Reporting & Performance

  • Auditer la qualité, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données Salesforce.
  • Analyser les reportings, dashboards et KPIs existants et leur adéquation avec les besoins métiers et de pilotage.
  • Identifier les améliorations nécessaires en matière de data quality, reporting et exploitation des données.

3. Business Analysis & Évolutions

  • Recueillir et formaliser les besoins des utilisateurs et des équipes métiers.
  • Identifier les opportunités d’optimisation des processus et des usages Salesforce.
  • Prioriser les évolutions en fonction de leur valeur métier et de leur complexité.
  • Cadrer les évolutions et assurer leur recette fonctionnelle.

4. Coordination IT & Cabinet Salesforce

  • Être l’interlocuteur référent Salesforce auprès des équipes métiers, de l’IT et du cabinet partenaire.
  • Piloter et coordonner les demandes et projets d’évolution avec le cabinet Salesforce.
  • Challenger les recommandations et solutions proposées par le cabinet.
  • Assurer le suivi des développements, des recettes et des mises en production.
  • Garantir la cohérence globale des évolutions avec les besoins métiers, l’architecture et les contraintes IT.

5. Roadmap & Recommandations

  • Construire une roadmap Salesforce à court, moyen et long terme.
  • Prioriser les actions et évolutions à mener.
  • Assurer un rôle de conseil et d’expertise auprès des équipes internes afin de maximiser la valeur et l’utilisation de Salesforce.

 

👉 Profil recherché

  • Solide expérience en audit, optimisation et évolution de Salesforce

  • Profil à la fois fonctionnel et technique

  • Bonne compréhension des enjeux métiers, data et processus

  • Capacité à challenger l’existant et être force de proposition

  • Forte autonomie et capacité à structurer une roadmap

  • Expérience dans la coordination avec les équipes IT et un cabinet Salesforce

  • Capacité à piloter les évolutions, développements et recettes

  • Excellentes qualités de communication et de gestion des parties prenantes

🎁 Nos avantages: 
 
• Un groupe international présent dans le monde entier
• Des entités pluridisciplinaires expertes dans leur domaine : programmatique, influence, RP, 360, création de contenus… 
• Possibilité de mobilité interne au sein des différentes entités du groupe
• De la formation continue avec une Digital Academy 
• Un accès à la plateforme HappyPal qui vous donnera accès à des réductions sur de nombreuses marques et loisirs (cinémas, concerts, parcs d’attractions, musées…)
• Des cours de sports quotidiens dans nos locaux : pilates, cross training
• Un forfait mobilité durable qui vous permet de louer un vélo auprès de notre partenaire BeeToGreen ou de vous faire rembourser à hauteur de 45€/mois votre location de vélo
• Prime de cooptation
 
Biggie Group propose des opportunités d'emploi sans distinction d’origine, de sexe, de moeurs, d’orientation sexuelle, d’identité de genre, d’âge, de situation familiale, d’apparence physique, de handicap, de religion, d’opinion politique… Biggie Group se conforme aux réglementations luttant contre la discrimination en entreprise. Cette politique s'applique tout au long du process employeur : le recrutement, l'embauche, la promotion interne, les congés, la rémunération et la formation.

title: Product Manager confirmé H/F - SaaS - Fintech
description: Qui sommes-nous ? N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, notre solution N2F s’impose comme une référence sur le marché français. N2F est une plateforme complète de Spend Management (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs, budget), conçue pour simplifier le quotidien des entreprises grâce à une expérience fluide, intuitive et 100 % connectée (web et mobile). Portés par une équipe engagée, qui place l’humain au centre de ses priorités , nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles. Pour accompagner cette croissance, nous recherchons un(e) Product Manager confirmé(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe Produit et prendre la responsabilité d’un domaine fonctionnel clé de notre plateforme. Le terrain de jeu est vaste et les défis nombreux : internationalisation, intelligence artificielle, agents, automatisation des workflows, interconnectivité, refonte fonctionnelle et amélioration continue de l’expérience utilisateur. Tes principales missions : Rattaché(e) à la VP Product, tu seras responsable d’un domaine fonctionnel de notre plateforme et de son évolution à long terme. Stratégie de Produit : Définir et porter la vision de ton domaine produit. Comprendre en profondeur les besoins des clients, des utilisateurs et des équipes internes. Analyser les tendances du marché, la concurrence et les évolutions technologiques afin d’identifier les meilleures opportunités de développement. Participer à l’identification et à l’évaluation de nouveaux cas d’usage liés à l’IA, à l’automatisation et aux agents. Gestion du Cycle de Vie du Produit : Construire et piloter la roadmap de ton périmètre. Identifier, qualifier et prioriser les opportunités en fonction de leur impact utilisateur et business. Superviser le cycle de vie complet des fonctionnalités, de la discovery au lancement avec le Product marketing. Mesurer les résultats et ajuster les orientations en fonction des retours terrain et des données. Développement de Produit : Piloter la conception et le développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités avec les équipes Product Design et Engineering. Garantir une expérience utilisateur simple, intuitive et performante. Valider les solutions proposées grâce à des tests utilisateurs, des analyses de données et des expérimentations. Veiller à délivrer des solutions pragmatiques, robustes et créatrices de valeur. Le travail collaboratif est au cœur du rôle : Travailler étroitement avec les équipes Sales, Customer Success et Support afin de comprendre les enjeux clients. Communiquer régulièrement avec les parties prenantes internes et externes. Favoriser l’alignement autour des priorités produit. Participer à la promotion du produit en interne et en externe. Contribuer à la diffusion de la culture Produit au sein de l’entreprise. Ce que l’on va attendre de toi : Tu disposes d’au moins 4 ans d’expérience en tant que Product Manager, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS B2B. Tu sais appréhender des problématiques métier complexes et les transformer en solutions simples et efficaces. Tu maîtrises les méthodologies agiles et les bonnes pratiques Produit. Tu es capable de piloter un sujet en autonomie et d’embarquer les équipes autour de tes projets. Tu sais arbitrer, prioriser et faire des choix pragmatiques et orientés impact. Tu as déjà mené des projets d’envergure impliquant plusieurs parties prenantes. Tu possèdes d’excellentes compétences en communication et en collaboration. Tu es curieux(se), rigoureux(se) et tu cherches à comprendre les sujets en profondeur avant de prendre des décisions. Tu disposes d’un esprit analytique fort tout en gardant une forte orientation utilisateur. Une sensibilité forte à l’IA est attendue Tu t’intéresses activement aux évolutions de l’intelligence artificielle et à leurs applications concrètes dans les produits SaaS. Tu utilises régulièrement des outils tels que ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini ou des assistants IA similaires dans ton quotidien professionnel. Tu sais identifier les opportunités où l’IA, les LLM, l’OCR ou les agents peuvent apporter une valeur tangible aux utilisateurs. Tu sais distinguer les effets de mode des usages réellement créateurs de valeur. Tu es bilingue Français / anglais. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Rejoindre une entreprise rentable, en forte croissance et ambitieuse à l’échelle européenne. Travailler sur un produit utilisé par plus d’un million d’utilisateurs à travers le monde. Évoluer dans une équipe Produit structurée composée de Product Managers, Product Designers et Product Marketing Manager. Contribuer à des sujets stratégiques mêlant SaaS, finance, IA et automatisation. Bénéficier d’un environnement collaboratif où les idées sont écoutées et où l’impact individuel est réel. Avoir la possibilité de délivrer rapidement de la valeur et de voir concrètement les résultats de son travail. Poste ouvert en CDI et full remote. #N2JSOFTFR #LI-DNP Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. The Role As a direct Business & Operations partner to our Solutions team, including Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers. You will work closely with Solutions leadership to build & scale the operating system that powers value realization across pre-sales and post-sales activities. You will translate our value vision into a scalable operating model by building automations, defining processes and ways of working, standing up KPIs and reporting, operationalising our internal ROI framework, feeding the feedback loop to capitalize on our successes, and embedding reusable value frameworks into customer engagements. This role is critical to turning our go-to-market strategy into repeatable, AI-native action, aligning delivery quality, output per FTE, and customer satisfaction to improve the efficiency and impact of our Solutions organisation and accelerate the value Mistral delivers to customers. What You Will Do Operating System & Automation Build the secure-by-design operating system that links our tooling stack to the Solutions team’s needs, and design the internal tools & automations that raise output per FTE. Streamline Deployment Strategist operations across pre-sales scoping and delivery, compounding shared knowledge, templates, and reusable IP. Drive daily adoption of our AI layer throughout the Solutions team, productising internal work into reusable assets for the team. Value Intelligence & ROI Operationalise the internal ROI framework per project / use case, defining and surfacing where we build value. Define the reporting layer and metric catalog (what we collect and surface) and build the dashboards that turn our data foundation into decisions and proof of value. Stand up the customer satisfaction measurement system (define, collect, surface) as a core input to value realization. raw.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain.

You will combine deep AI engineering expertise with product and business understanding to identify high-impact opportunities, define roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes.

As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

Annual gross salary range (package): €90,000 – €100,000

This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Principal AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Own Tech Strategy for Your Domain

  • Identify high-value opportunities with Business leaders
  • Define the Tech vision and own the agent product roadmap for your domain

2. Lead AI System Development

  • Design and build production-grade AI systems
  • Drive architecture decisions
  • Ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability

3. Drive Adoption & Business Impact

  • Work closely with end users
  • Measure adoption and outcomes
  • Accelerate AI transformation across your domain

4. Establish Technical Excellence

  • Promote best practices for evaluation, testing, guardrails, and observability
  • Review designs and mentor engineers
  • Raise the quality bar across initiatives

5. Grow AI Capability

  • Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders
  • Share knowledge and reusable components
  • Build AI expertise within your organization

Success Metrics

  • Business impact delivered by AI initiatives
  • Adoption within the domain
  • Technical quality and reliability
  • Team capability growth

 

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL
  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models
  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases
  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

 

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 7+ years in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Applied AI
  • Strong experience with LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, evaluation, and production systems
  • Ability to influence Product and Business decisions
  • Proven leadership on complex cross-functional initiatives

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

title: Director of Cybersecurity & IT
description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? Back Market is looking for a Director of Cybersecurity & IT to define and lead the next phase of our security and technology operations maturity. Reporting to the VP of Platform Engineering, you will be a strategic leader at the intersection of cybersecurity, IT, risk, compliance, and business growth. You will lead a multi-disciplinary organization through its existing functional managers, creating the clarity, operating rhythm, and investment focus needed to protect Back Market while enabling the company to move quickly. The scope includes cybersecurity strategy and risk management, security operations, governance and compliance, IT operations, IT support, and the corporate technology foundations that keep our people productive and our business resilient. This is a director-level role, not a super-sized operational manager role. You will not be expected to personally own every process or make every technical decision. Your impact will come from setting direction, developing leaders, aligning stakeholders, making sound investment choices, and ensuring that the organization delivers measurable outcomes. You will be the senior voice who makes cybersecurity and IT understandable, actionable, and connected to the business. To know more about our engineering teams: A video of our VP Platform: https://youtu.be/zvTlw4BNNdc Our company purpose: http://bit.ly/3OsScpl Our engineering blog: https://bit.ly/3ASJNID How we work with the existing teams 💚 The Director sets direction, creates clarity, secures resources, removes organizational obstacles, develops leaders, and ensures that the overall portfolio delivers against agreed outcomes. The functional managers and senior experts retain ownership of day-to-day execution, technical practices, operational processes, and delivery within their domains. The Director creates the conditions for those leaders to succeed and makes sure their work adds up to a coherent company-wide strategy. Your next missions 👇 Set the strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities Define and evolve a multi-year Cybersecurity & IT strategy aligned with Back Market's business goals, risk appetite, technology strategy, and growth plans Translate that strategy into a focused portfolio of initiatives, with clear outcomes, sequencing, ownership, dependencies, and measures of success Own the operating rhythm for the full scope: planning, budgeting, program tracking, KPI and SLA reporting, risk reviews, and executive communication Make pragmatic investment and prioritization recommendations, balancing resilience, customer trust, regulatory expectations, employee experience, and engineering velocity Establish the governance forums and decision mechanisms needed to keep priorities clear and accountability visible Lead and grow a high-performing leadership organization Lead through the managers and senior individual contributors responsible for Security Operations, Governance Risk & Compliance, IT Operations Engineering, IT Support, and relevant security engineering or product security capabilities Coach, challenge, and develop your leaders, helping them grow their scope, judgment, influence, and ability to build strong teams of their own Create clear career paths, succession plans, and development opportunities across the organization Build a high-trust environment where teams have genuine ownership, collaborate across boundaries, and are encouraged to improve how work gets done Attract and retain exceptional talent, define what great leadership and execution look like, and continuously raise the bar without creating unnecessary bureaucracy Ensure that responsibilities, decision rights, and interfaces between the teams are explicit, understood, and respected Turn cybersecurity into a business enabler Act as a trusted advisor to the VP of Engineering, CTO, Executive Committee, and senior leaders across the business Explain complex security, IT, and risk topics in clear business language, including the trade-offs, options, costs, and consequences of different decisions Engage with Heads of and cross-functional streams across Back Market to advocate for security and resilience in all areas of the business Build alignment rather than relying on authority, and help teams adopt secure and resilient ways of working because they understand the rationale and value Partner with Finance and senior technology leadership on investment cases, budget stewardship, vendor strategy, and the value delivered by the portfolio Steer enterprise cyber risk and trust Own the cyber risk management process at the strategic level, using the GRC framework as the foundation for security decisions and prioritization Ensure that material risks, control gaps, exceptions, and remediation plans are visible, understood, and actively managed Escalate critical risks when they exceed the organization's risk appetite or require executive arbitration Support security compliance efforts across the organization, ensuring alignment and buy-in from peers and key stakeholders across ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, NIS2, and contractual partner requirements Partner with the VP Legal and DPO on the company's data privacy strategy, ensuring privacy and security requirements are considered early in business, product, and technology decisions Represent Back Market's security maturity and risk posture to investors, auditors, regulators, strategic partners, and major customers Serve as the senior escalation point for major or complex security incidents, ensuring the right executive communication, decision-making, learning, and follow-through without displacing the operational ownership of the incident response teams Enable secure products and resilient technology Partner with Engineering, Product, and other Bureau of Technology directors to ensure security requirements are integrated into product and feature development from the beginning Sponsor and evolve Product Security and secure software development lifecycle practices, including security-by-design, threat modeling, appropriate testing, and pragmatic guardrails Ensure the security roadmap addresses the most important risks across cloud infrastructure, corporate systems, identity and access, endpoints, applications, data, and third-party services Set the expectations for Security Operations across threat intelligence, vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident readiness, risk assessment and project design reviews, fraud support, AI security, and associated SLA and KPI tracking Ensure IT Operations and IT Support provide a reliable, scalable, and high-quality experience for Back Makers across our global offices and remote workforce Champion automation, standardization, and engineering-led approaches that reduce manual work and improve reliability, while leaving day-to-day technical ownership with the appropriate functional teams Build security culture and external credibility Foster a security-aware culture through clear communication about the evolving threat landscape, key initiatives, practical expectations, and the role every Back Maker plays in protecting the company Sponsor awareness, education, and Security Champion programs that make secure behavior accessible and relevant to different audiences Represent Back Market in relevant security communities, industry groups, partner forums, and regulatory conversations Build trusted relationships with strategic technology partners, auditors, insurers, and external security providers Help Back Market demonstrate that strong security, responsible technology, and business agility reinforce one another You could be a good fit if you've: A proven track record of building, scaling, and developing organizations that span multiple security and/or IT domains 12 to 15+ years of experience across cybersecurity, information security, IT, or related technology leadership roles, including at least 5 years leading managers and multi-team organizations Experience operating as a strategic partner to a CTO, VP Engineering, executive committee, or equivalent senior leadership group Proven expertise and a solid grasp of the domains listed below: security operations, cyber risk and governance, compliance and assurance, security architecture, product security, cloud security, IT operations, or corporate technology Demonstrated ability to turn business strategy and risk appetite into a practical security and IT roadmap, investment plan, and operating model Experience communicating security and technology risk to executive, board-level, investor, partner, audit, and non-technical audiences A mature, risk-based approach. You understand that perfect security does not exist, and that good leadership means making explicit, informed trade-offs and focusing resources where they have the greatest impact Experience leading through managers and senior experts, with a genuine passion for developing people, building leadership capability, and creating meaningful career paths Strong understanding of modern cloud, SaaS, identity, endpoint, application, data, and infrastructure security concepts, even if you are not the deepest technical expert in every domain Experience with security-by-design, secure software development lifecycle practices, and effective partnership with Engineering and Product teams Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to make complex topics clear, concrete, and compelling. raw.title: Director of Cybersecurity & IT
raw.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

Back Market is looking for a Director of Cybersecurity & IT to define and lead the next phase of our security and technology operations maturity. Reporting to the VP of Platform Engineering, you will be a strategic leader at the intersection of cybersecurity, IT, risk, compliance, and business growth.

You will lead a multi-disciplinary organization through its existing functional managers, creating the clarity, operating rhythm, and investment focus needed to protect Back Market while enabling the company to move quickly. The scope includes cybersecurity strategy and risk management, security operations, governance and compliance, IT operations, IT support, and the corporate technology foundations that keep our people productive and our business resilient.

 

This is a director-level role, not a super-sized operational manager role. You will not be expected to personally own every process or make every technical decision. Your impact will come from setting direction, developing leaders, aligning stakeholders, making sound investment choices, and ensuring that the organization delivers measurable outcomes. You will be the senior voice who makes cybersecurity and IT understandable, actionable, and connected to the business.

 

To know more about our engineering teams:

  • A video of our VP Platform: https://youtu.be/zvTlw4BNNdc

  • Our company purpose: http://bit.ly/3OsScpl

  • Our engineering blog: https://bit.ly/3ASJNID

How we work with the existing teams 💚

 

The Director sets direction, creates clarity, secures resources, removes organizational obstacles, develops leaders, and ensures that the overall portfolio delivers against agreed outcomes. The functional managers and senior experts retain ownership of day-to-day execution, technical practices, operational processes, and delivery within their domains. The Director creates the conditions for those leaders to succeed and makes sure their work adds up to a coherent company-wide strategy.

Your next missions 👇

 

Set the strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities

  • Define and evolve a multi-year Cybersecurity & IT strategy aligned with Back Market's business goals, risk appetite, technology strategy, and growth plans

  • Translate that strategy into a focused portfolio of initiatives, with clear outcomes, sequencing, ownership, dependencies, and measures of success

  • Own the operating rhythm for the full scope: planning, budgeting, program tracking, KPI and SLA reporting, risk reviews, and executive communication

  • Make pragmatic investment and prioritization recommendations, balancing resilience, customer trust, regulatory expectations, employee experience, and engineering velocity

  • Establish the governance forums and decision mechanisms needed to keep priorities clear and accountability visible

 

Lead and grow a high-performing leadership organization

  • Lead through the managers and senior individual contributors responsible for Security Operations, Governance Risk & Compliance, IT Operations Engineering, IT Support, and relevant security engineering or product security capabilities

  • Coach, challenge, and develop your leaders, helping them grow their scope, judgment, influence, and ability to build strong teams of their own

  • Create clear career paths, succession plans, and development opportunities across the organization

  • Build a high-trust environment where teams have genuine ownership, collaborate across boundaries, and are encouraged to improve how work gets done

  • Attract and retain exceptional talent, define what great leadership and execution look like, and continuously raise the bar without creating unnecessary bureaucracy

  • Ensure that responsibilities, decision rights, and interfaces between the teams are explicit, understood, and respected

 

Turn cybersecurity into a business enabler

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the VP of Engineering, CTO, Executive Committee, and senior leaders across the business

  • Explain complex security, IT, and risk topics in clear business language, including the trade-offs, options, costs, and consequences of different decisions

  • Engage with Heads of and cross-functional streams across Back Market to advocate for security and resilience in all areas of the business

  • Build alignment rather than relying on authority, and help teams adopt secure and resilient ways of working because they understand the rationale and value

  • Partner with Finance and senior technology leadership on investment cases, budget stewardship, vendor strategy, and the value delivered by the portfolio

 

Steer enterprise cyber risk and trust

  • Own the cyber risk management process at the strategic level, using the GRC framework as the foundation for security decisions and prioritization

  • Ensure that material risks, control gaps, exceptions, and remediation plans are visible, understood, and actively managed

  • Escalate critical risks when they exceed the organization's risk appetite or require executive arbitration

  • Support security compliance efforts across the organization, ensuring alignment and buy-in from peers and key stakeholders across ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, NIS2, and contractual partner requirements

  • Partner with the VP Legal and DPO on the company's data privacy strategy, ensuring privacy and security requirements are considered early in business, product, and technology decisions

  • Represent Back Market's security maturity and risk posture to investors, auditors, regulators, strategic partners, and major customers

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for major or complex security incidents, ensuring the right executive communication, decision-making, learning, and follow-through without displacing the operational ownership of the incident response teams

 

Enable secure products and resilient technology

  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and other Bureau of Technology directors to ensure security requirements are integrated into product and feature development from the beginning

  • Sponsor and evolve Product Security and secure software development lifecycle practices, including security-by-design, threat modeling, appropriate testing, and pragmatic guardrails

  • Ensure the security roadmap addresses the most important risks across cloud infrastructure, corporate systems, identity and access, endpoints, applications, data, and third-party services

  • Set the expectations for Security Operations across threat intelligence, vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident readiness, risk assessment and project design reviews, fraud support, AI security, and associated SLA and KPI tracking

  • Ensure IT Operations and IT Support provide a reliable, scalable, and high-quality experience for Back Makers across our global offices and remote workforce

  • Champion automation, standardization, and engineering-led approaches that reduce manual work and improve reliability, while leaving day-to-day technical ownership with the appropriate functional teams

 

Build security culture and external credibility

  • Foster a security-aware culture through clear communication about the evolving threat landscape, key initiatives, practical expectations, and the role every Back Maker plays in protecting the company

  • Sponsor awareness, education, and Security Champion programs that make secure behavior accessible and relevant to different audiences

  • Represent Back Market in relevant security communities, industry groups, partner forums, and regulatory conversations

  • Build trusted relationships with strategic technology partners, auditors, insurers, and external security providers

  • Help Back Market demonstrate that strong security, responsible technology, and business agility reinforce one another


You could be a good fit if you've:

  • A proven track record of building, scaling, and developing organizations that span multiple security and/or IT domains

  • 12 to 15+ years of experience across cybersecurity, information security, IT, or related technology leadership roles, including at least 5 years leading managers and multi-team organizations

  • Experience operating as a strategic partner to a CTO, VP Engineering, executive committee, or equivalent senior leadership group

  • Proven expertise and a solid grasp of the domains listed below: security operations, cyber risk and governance, compliance and assurance, security architecture, product security, cloud security, IT operations, or corporate technology

  • Demonstrated ability to turn business strategy and risk appetite into a practical security and IT roadmap, investment plan, and operating model

  • Experience communicating security and technology risk to executive, board-level, investor, partner, audit, and non-technical audiences

  • A mature, risk-based approach. You understand that perfect security does not exist, and that good leadership means making explicit, informed trade-offs and focusing resources where they have the greatest impact

  • Experience leading through managers and senior experts, with a genuine passion for developing people, building leadership capability, and creating meaningful career paths

  • Strong understanding of modern cloud, SaaS, identity, endpoint, application, data, and infrastructure security concepts, even if you are not the deepest technical expert in every domain

  • Experience with security-by-design, secure software development lifecycle practices, and effective partnership with Engineering and Product teams

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to make complex topics clear, concrete, and compelling. French is a plus

  • The judgment, calm, and influence required to operate effectively in ambiguity, during incidents, and across competing stakeholder priorities

  • Genuine excitement about Back Market's mission and the belief that cybersecurity and IT are essential enablers of sustainable growth

    Nice to have

  • A recognized certification such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, or an equivalent professional qualification

  • Experience with ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, NIS2, or other relevant European regulatory and assurance frameworks

  • Experience with GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, modern cloud-native security tooling, or SaaS-first environments

  • Experience in marketplace, e-commerce, fintech, or another business with meaningful customer, partner, or regulatory trust requirements

  • Experience with AI security, fraud prevention, third-party risk, or software supply chain security

  • Experience working in a fast-growing, international organization with distributed

    Hiring process

    1. Phone call with Marie, Technical Talent Acquisition Partner - 45 min

    2. Deep-dive interview on cybersecurity and IT strategy with your future manager, the VP of Engineering - 60 min

    3. Leadership and management interview with a peer Engineering Director and an Engineering Manager - 60 min

    4. Meet your future team - 45 min

    5. Stakeholder interview with cross-functional partners, including the CTO and relevant Security and IT leaders - 60 min

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Backend + Frontend)
description: Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call. Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a  Senior Full-Stack Engineer  to build the platform that catches data problems before they become business problems. About Us Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing. Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo. The Role You'll work across our entire stack: Java backend services and the TypeScript/Angular frontend that power Soda Cloud. We're product engineers, not ticket-takers: you'll own features end-to-end, talk to users, shape the design with your PM, and ship from database to UI without waiting for hand-offs. We also build agentically: AI coding agents are part of the daily workflow here, not an experiment on the side. What You'll Do Build features end-to-end: backend APIs, database changes, frontend UI, and ship them to production yourself. Design and implement backend services for a multi-tenant SaaS platform. Work with relational databases (MySQL): schema design, query optimization, data modeling. Build frontend features that are clean, fast, and don't get in the way. Optimize performance across the stack and write tests at every layer (unit, integration, e2e).   • Build agentic features into the product: LLM-powered workflows that help users find, understand, and fix data issues.

  2. 20-minute phone screen

  4. Second technical interview (60 min)
